name: Nitrogen adsorption isotherm and BET surface-area analysis at 77 K
plain_name: Nitrogen adsorption isotherm and BET surface-area analysis at 77 K
description: Determine surface area of an activated porous solid through volumetric nitrogen adsorption in a liquid-nitrogen bath, following the published TriStar II Plus method.

sources.citation: RSC supplementary information c9cc00626e: gas sorption methods
Micromeritics, Minimum Surface Area Measurements with Physisorption Analyzers

requirements.rationale: The reported nitrogen adsorption temperature is 77 K.
Metered gas dosing, pressure readout and adsorption manifold are indispensable.

missing_information: Activation protocol, dead-volume calibration, relative-pressure fitting range, sample mass and BET validity for the chosen adsorbent must be confirmed; no surface-area result is fabricated.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
